title: Pacers at Hardrock - Pacer and Crew Rules
claims: In 2027 pacers are allowed from Grouse Gulch onward.
Pacers may meet and start their runner only at crew-access aid stations from Grouse Gulch onward - Ouray, Telluride and Chapman - and at KT if they hike in, for pacer exchange only.
Runners over 60 may have pacers for the whole run.
Pacers must run at least the whole leg to the next crew access or specifically allowed aid station.
All pacers must check in with aid station personnel and sign a waiver; they receive a wristband that must be worn on course.
Crewing is generally limited to a 400-yard radius of the aid station.
Runners receive a single crew pass that allows one crew vehicle to park at Cunningham and Grouse Gulch.
No crew, spectator, media, parking or drop-offs are allowed along Ophir Pass Road.
Pets are not allowed in the main aid station area or on course with runners.
Family and friends may join runners for the final mile from the southern end of the Nute Chute.
Pacers may not leave vehicles at Grouse Gulch to be picked up after the run.
